text:
zoe: Montclair Health wants Redwood to be a drop-in replacement for HeliosAPI. Minimal client changes, identical sync + webhook async shapes, and security questionnaire due Friday. Can we POC?
rahul: Yes, but we need to scope exact compatibility: Helios uses top-level `context` + `dedupe_key`, chunked JSON streaming, and webhook callbacks for long runs. Also they expect `X-Helios-Limit` headers.
ivy: +1. Main engineering work is a small proxy that maps fields and frames streams the same way. Also need idempotency handling for `dedupe_key` -> map to our idempotency keys.
matt: Security: Montclair is HIPAA; they asked for BAA, KMS details, audit retention, and mTLS for management endpoints. sec-bot: Hosted cannot accept customer-supplied long-lived tokens; use auth-proxy pattern.
zoe: customer pasted example request and callback (trimmed) in doc.
zoe: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer HELIOS_KEY" -d '{"context":"Patient note","max_length":300,"callback_url":"https://montclair/cb","dedupe_key":"d-1"}' https://api.helios.ai/v2/complete`
rahul: Plan: 1) build compatibility proxy that accepts Helios routes, maps payloads to Redwood API, preserves headers, maps errors (422/409), and POSTs callback_url with Helios-shaped body. 2) run parity tests on N=50 canonical notes. 3) 30-day pilot with fallback routing.
ivy: ETA for prototype shim: ~2 business days if we get cURL samples and webhook signing secret. I'll push a staging endpoint.
matt: I'll own the questionnaire + BAA draft. Hosted = Redwood-managed KMS; Dedicated = customer-managed keys and mTLS.
rahul: Note: exact byte-level parity unlikely due to tokenization/sampling differences and Helios post-process filters. We'll agree acceptance as clinical QA metrics (entity F1 + manual checks).
zoe: Pricing ask: they want existing per-req price for 60 days. Sales can offer pilot credit or blended short-term rate; finance needs to sign off.
ivy: deploy-bot: deploy started by ivy for branch shim/montclair-compat at commit c0ffee - staging proxy: https://staging-proxy.redwood.net/helios/v2/complete
deploy-bot: staging up. basic flows pass; streaming wrapper needs final EOF frame fix.
rahul: I'll run an initial parity check on 50 examples once montclair uploads them to the shared drive.
zoe: Action items: ivy -> prototype + staging, rahul -> parity eval, matt -> questionnaire & BAA, zoe -> SOW + pricing ask. I'll update Montclair with the POC plan and request canonical prompt set and metric thresholds. :thumbsup:
